AWI-ESM 1 REcoM (2024): 
aerosol: none
atmos: ECHAM6.3.04p1 (T63L47 native atmosphere T63 gaussian grid; 192 x 96 longitude/latitude; 47 levels; top level 80 km)
atmosChem: none
land: JSBACH 3.20 with dynamic vegetation
landIce: none
ocean: FESOM 1.4 (unstructured grid in the horizontal with 126859 wet nodes; 46 levels; top grid cell 0-5 m)
ocnBgchem: REcoM2 (same grid as ocean component)
seaIce: FESOM 1.4 (same grid as ocean component)
institution: Alfred Wegener Institute, Helmholtz Centre for Polar and Marine Research, Am Handelshafen 12, 27570 Bremerhaven, Germany
experiment: all-forcing simulation of the recent past
grid: All grid attributes are set for the native grid and based on information from attribute source.

aridity_index.description: Calculated from precipitation and potential evapotranspiration.
aridity_index.comment: Aridity index is the ratio of precipitation to potential evapotranspiration. It is a measure of the degree of dryness of the climate at a given location. A value of 1 indicates that precipitation is equal to potential evapotranspiration, values greater than 1 indicate that precipitation is greater than potential evapotranspiration, and values less than 1 indicate that precipitation is less than potential evapotranspiration.
